stepTitle:
Ishani trains two models on the same data with the same features: Model A and Model B. Information on both models is given below:
• Model A: bias squared $$2$$, model variance $$12$$
• Model B: bias squared $$4$$, model variance $$1$$
Which of the following statements are true? Select all that apply.
stepBody: Model A could have used Ridge Regression with $$\lambda>0$$ while Model B used OLS.
